surfaces.says: The scheduler endpoint the platform cron calls: with the exact bearer it runs every feature's due jobs and mail passes in one tick; a call without that bearer gets 401 and runs nothing, and a deployment with no cron secret set answers 503.
The Resend webhook that records delivery, bounce and open callbacks for sent mail: it refuses any method but a signed POST.

behaviors.says: A signed callback records one delivery outcome for the sent mail, and a callback with a bad signature writes nothing.

tests.name: AC:CASE-NTF-010 AC:SEC-09 AC:SEC-06 AC:NOTIFY47-008 callbacks record one outcome and a bad signature writes nothing

behaviors.noOperation: the Resend webhook handler (server/jobs/webhook-route.ts) verifies the signature and the mail callback job records the outcome; it is a provider callback, not a catalog operation
